newsitem.title: USA: VSI Enterprises sees Q4 revs over $6 mln.
newsitem.headline: VSI Enterprises sees Q4 revs over $6 mln.

text.p: VSI Enterprises Inc on Thursday said it expected to report revenue of more than $6 million for the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The company also said it would restate its third-quarter results, though it did not expect the revision to affect the loss of $0.05 per share initially recorded for the period.

VSI, a network multimedia and videoconferencing concern, said the restatement reflected a reconciliation in the records of INS, which it acquired June 28. The revision will reduce revenue by about $500,000 and increase its net loss of about $200,000.
The company said its fourth-quarter revenues of about $6 million marked an increase of about 60 percent over the restated third-quarter revenues.
The increase is a "an indication that VSI's network-oriented strategy is beginning to pay off," said Richard Snelling, the company's chairman and chief executive.

Snelling also said that the company's first-quarter revenues in 1997 will benefit from business from new domestic and international videoconferencing customers such as General DataComm Industries Inc.
He did not give specific estimates. Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
VSI will announce complete fourth quarter and 1996 year-end results in mid-to-late February, it said.
VSI stock was 7/32 higher at 2-13/32 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
